blockers.detail: Fresh Copilot review at 2026-09-08T15:30:52Z reported that save/crop handling still floors the fractional viewport and reconstructs the zoomed save from integer saveX/saveY rather than carrying the fractional source offset and destination compensation used by WM_PAINT. The comment targets src/modules/ZoomIt/ZoomIt/Zoomit.cpp around lines 10917-10920 and also references the annotation rendering path around line 11636.
blockers.remediation: Centralize or persist the fractional viewport transform so rendering, save/crop output, annotation input/conversion, clipping, and invalidation all use the same source bounds and destination compensation; then rebuild the required ZoomIt sequence, reply to and resolve the thread, and request a fresh Copilot review.

blockers.detail: Fresh Copilot review at 2026-09-08T15:30:52Z reported that the non-composited live-zoom Ctrl+Up/Ctrl+Down path updates zoomLevel and stops the animation but leaves transformDirty false, so with the cursor inside movement boundaries the next timer tick may build no matrix and may not call the magnifier transform API. The comment targets src/modules/ZoomIt/ZoomIt/Zoomit.cpp around lines 12249-12250.
blockers.remediation: Mark the transform dirty after stopping the animation on the non-DWM path, matching the show-path behavior; then rebuild the required ZoomIt sequence, reply to and resolve the thread, and request a fresh Copilot review.
